items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like I always say, like Dexter used to say, “bebop is the future.”

ctx.x: So Dexter didn’t say anything, he split, went back to L.A. I said, “Aw jeez, it’s too late to get anybody. That kills it.” So a friend of mine came up with the idea, he says, “Well why don’t you do it on Bird’s Birthday, August 29th? The weather will be better, and it will be more celebratory than a sad thing.” So I said, “That’s a good idea.” And then we started to do that. Then in 1980 I made it a month, August is Charlie Parker month. So we took the whole month of August, culminating with August 29th, his…
